label: Deposits protected per account holder at each bank, building society or credit union
context: The most the Financial Claims Scheme protects for one account holder at one authorised deposit-taking institution if the Government activates the scheme after that institution fails.

label: General insurance claims covered in most cases
context: Most claims by policyholders and other claimants against a failed general insurer are covered up to this amount. Claims over it are covered for eligible policyholders and certain third parties.
